notes.title: Square Enix удалила Denuvo из Valkyrie Elysium для ПК
notes.notes: Square Enix выпустила обновление для экшен-RPG Valkyrie Elysium, разработкой которой занималась студия Soleil. Спустя четыре месяца после выхода игры в Steam компания удалила антипиратскую защиту Denuvo, что привело к уменьшению исполняемого файла на 280 МБ.

[list]
[*] If Divine Art/Einherjar and a shortcut key for an item have the same key assigned, Divine Art/Einherjar will now take priority over that shortcut key.
[*] Mouse wheel is now available for key assign. 
[*] Tab key is now available for key assign. 
[*] Separate from the Soul Chain key assign option, there is now an individual key assign option for Actions.
[*] Players can now also control the cursor with the mouse wheel or arrow keys.
[*] Players can now also perform Confirm action with Enter key, Cancel action with Esc/Backspace key.
[*] Changed key assigns for some of the functionalities. 
[*] The changes that have been made to the default setting for the options in the Customize have no effect on players who are already playing the game.
[/list]

notes.title: VALKYRIE ELYSIUM is available now!
notes.notes:
In an unjust world, what will you choose??

VALKYRIE ELYSIUM is the latest title in the VALKYRIE series that depicts the death of humankind and the existence of the gods with a unique worldview based on Norse mythology.

Motoi Sakuraba’s masterful compositions enhance the new world of VALKYRIE, depicted with high-end graphics.
As the first action RPG of the series, VALKYRIE ELYSIUM retains the familiar special attacks and combo system while simultaneously taking combat to the next level with a new, three-dimensional, fast-paced battle system.

notes.title: VALKYRIE ELYSIUM Early Access Available Now!
notes.notes:
[b]Customers who pre-purchase VALKYRIE ELYSIUM can play the game now![/b]

The latest title in the VALKYRIE series is finally here! This action RPG incorporates the series' signature Einherjar and combo systems, allowing players to enjoy speedy, three-dimensional combat. The game's unique art style beautifully depicts a collapsing world as Ragnarok looms, with series veteran Motoi Sakuraba returning to enrich the title with an unforgettable soundtrack. 
 
[b]◆Story [/b]
Long ago, 
Ragnarok—the End Times—loomed upon the realms. 
The All-Father Odin, with the last of his strength, created an emissary of redemption, Valkyrie; her sole task being the salvation of a doomed world.
